title.de: Some und any: some bread, any milk
title.sl: Some in any: some bread, any milk
title.it: Some e any: some bread, any milk

goal.sl: Ločiš, kaj se šteje in kaj ne, rečeš some v trdilnem stavku, ponudbi in prošnji, any v zanikanem stavku in vprašanju ter izpustiš a pri bread, milk ali news.
goal.de: Du unterscheidest, was man zählt und was nicht, sagst some im bejahten Satz, im Angebot und in der Bitte, any im verneinten Satz und in der Frage, und lässt a bei bread, milk oder news weg.
goal.it: Distingui ciò che si conta da ciò che non si conta, dici some nelle frasi affermative, nelle offerte e nelle richieste, any nelle frasi negative e nelle domande, e non metti a con bread, milk o news.
goal.en: You can tell what can and can't be counted, say some in yes sentences, offers and requests, any in no sentences and questions, and leave out a with bread, milk or news.

say.sl: Nekatere stvari lahko šteješ: **an egg** (eno jajce), **two eggs** (dve jajci), **a sheep**, **fifty sheep** (petdeset ovc). Drugih ne: **bread** (kruh), **milk** (mleko), **tea** (čaj), **honey** (med). Te nimajo množine in ne dobijo **a**: nikoli *a bread*, *breads*.
say.de: Manches kann man zählen: **an egg** (ein Ei), **two eggs** (zwei Eier), **a sheep**, **fifty sheep** (fünfzig Schafe). Anderes nicht: **bread** (Brot), **milk** (Milch), **tea** (Tee), **honey** (Honig). Das hat keinen Plural und kein **a**: nie *a bread*, *breads*.
say.it: Alcune cose si contano: **an egg** (un uovo), **two eggs** (due uova), **a sheep**, **fifty sheep** (cinquanta pecore). Altre no: **bread** (pane), **milk** (latte), **tea** (tè), **honey** (miele). Queste non hanno plurale e non prendono **a**: mai *a bread*, *breads*.
say.en: Some things you can count: **an egg**, **two eggs**, **a sheep**, **fifty sheep**. Others you can't: **tea**, **milk**, **honey**. These have no plural and take no **a**: **bread** (never *a bread*).

examples.en: There are two eggs on the table.
examples.de: Auf dem Tisch liegen zwei Eier.
examples.it: Sul tavolo ci sono due uova.

explain.sl:
**Kruha ne šteješ: brez a, brez -s**
- We've got bread. · We've got milk.
explain.de:
**Brot zählt man nicht: kein a, kein -s**
- We've got bread. · We've got milk.
explain.it:
**Il pane non si conta: niente a, niente -s**
- We've got bread. · We've got milk.
explain.en:
**You can't count bread: no a, no -s**
- We've got bread. · We've got milk.

say.sl: **some** (nekaj) je za količino, ki je ne poveš natančno, v trdilnem stavku: **We've got some eggs.** (Imamo nekaj jajc.) **There's some bread on the table.** (Na mizi je nekaj kruha.) Stoji z množino in s tem, česar ne šteješ.
say.de: **some** (etwas, ein paar) steht für eine Menge, die du nicht genau angibst, im bejahten Satz: **We've got some eggs.** (Wir haben ein paar Eier.) **There's some bread on the table.** (Auf dem Tisch ist etwas Brot.) Es steht beim Plural und bei Unzählbarem.
say.it: **some** (del, dei, un po' di) indica una quantità non precisa, nelle frasi affermative: **We've got some eggs.** (Abbiamo delle uova.) **There's some bread on the table.** (Sul tavolo c'è del pane.) Va con il plurale e con ciò che non si conta.
say.en: **some** is for an amount you don't give exactly, in a yes sentence: **We've got some eggs.** **There's some bread on the table.** It goes with a plural and with what you can't count.

examples.en: There's some bread on the table.
examples.de: Auf dem Tisch ist etwas Brot.

explain.sl:
**Trdilni stavek, mleka ne šteješ: some**
- some milk · some eggs
explain.de:
**Bejahter Satz, Milch zählt man nicht: some**
- some milk · some eggs
explain.it:
**Frase affermativa, il latte non si conta: some**
- some milk · some eggs
explain.en:
**A yes sentence, you can't count milk: some**
- some milk · some eggs

say.sl: V zanikanem stavku je **any**: **We haven't got any eggs.** (Nimamo jajc.) **There isn't any milk.** (Mleka ni.), nikoli *There isn't some milk.* Tako pri tem, kar šteješ, kot pri tem, česar ne. Slovenščina tu nima posebne besede.
say.de: Im verneinten Satz steht **any**: **We haven't got any eggs.** (Wir haben keine Eier.) **There isn't any milk.** (Es ist keine Milch da.), nie *There isn't some milk.* Das Deutsche sagt kein, das Englische **not** + **any**.
say.it: Nelle frasi negative si usa **any**: **We haven't got any eggs.** (Non abbiamo uova.) **There isn't any milk.** (Non c'è latte.), mai *There isn't some milk.* Vale per ciò che si conta e per ciò che non si conta.
say.en: In a no sentence it's **any**: **We haven't got any eggs.** **There isn't any milk.** (never *There isn't some milk.*) It's the same for what you can count and what you can't.

examples.en: Mrs Birkett hasn't got any scones today.
examples.de: Frau Birkett hat heute keine Scones.
examples.it: La signora Birkett oggi non ha scones.

say.sl: Tudi večina vprašanj ima **any**: **Have you got any honey?** (Imaš kaj medu?) **Are there any fish in the tarn?** (So v gorskem jezeru kakšne ribe?) V odgovoru stojita **some** in **any** tudi sama: **Yes, I've got some.** (Ja, nekaj ga imam.) **No, I haven't got any.** (Ne, nimam ga.)
say.de: Auch die meisten Fragen haben **any**: **Have you got any honey?** (Hast du Honig?) **Are there any fish in the tarn?** (Gibt es Fische im Bergsee?) In der Antwort stehen **some** und **any** auch allein: **Yes, I've got some.** (Ja, ich habe welchen.) **No, I haven't got any.** (Nein, ich habe keinen.)
say.it: Anche la maggior parte delle domande ha **any**: **Have you got any honey?** (Hai del miele?) **Are there any fish in the tarn?** (Ci sono pesci nel laghetto?) Nella risposta **some** e **any** stanno anche da soli: **Yes, I've got some.** (Sì, ne ho.) **No, I haven't got any.** (No, non ne ho.)
say.en: Most questions take **any** too: **Have you got any honey?** **Are there any fish in the tarn?** In the answer **some** and **any** can stand alone: **Yes, I've got some.** **No, I haven't got any.**

**Vprašanje: any; some le, ko pričakuješ da**

explain.de:

explain.it:

explain.en:

say.sl: V ponudbi ali prošnji je **some**, saj pričakuješ da: **Would you like some tea?** (Bi čaj?) **Can I have some water, please?** (Lahko dobim vodo, prosim?) **Have some cake!** (Vzemi malo torte!)
say.de: Im Angebot und in der Bitte steht **some**, denn du erwartest ein Ja: **Would you like some tea?** (Möchtest du Tee?) **Can I have some water, please?** (Kann ich bitte Wasser haben?) **Have some cake!** (Nimm dir Kuchen!)
say.it: Per offrire o chiedere si usa **some**, perché ci si aspetta un sì: **Would you like some tea?** (Vuoi del tè?) **Can I have some water, please?** (Posso avere dell'acqua, per favore?) **Have some cake!** (Prendi un po' di torta!)
say.en: An offer or a request takes **some**, as you expect yes: **Would you like some tea?** **Can I have some water, please?** **Have some cake!**

examples.en: Would you like some tea, Mr Dixon?
Can I have some water, please?

examples.it: Prendi un po' di torta, Sam!

say.sl: Kar ne šteješ, na splošno ne dobi člena: **Honey is sweet.** (Med je sladek.) **I like tea.** (Rad{m:|f:a} imam čaj.) Tudi **news** (novice), **advice** (nasvet) in **money** (denar) v angleščini ne štejemo: **The news is good.** (Novice so dobre.) Ko vseeno šteješ: **a loaf of bread** (hlebec kruha), **a piece of advice** (en nasvet), **a cup of tea** (skodelica čaja), nikoli *a bread*.
say.de: Was man nicht zählt, bekommt allgemein keinen Artikel: **Honey is sweet.** (Honig ist süß.) **I like tea.** (Ich mag Tee.) Auch **news** (Nachrichten), **advice** (Rat) und **money** (Geld) zählt das Englische nicht: **The news is good.** (Die Nachrichten sind gut.) Zum Zählen: **a loaf of bread** (ein Laib Brot), **a piece of advice** (ein Rat), **a cup of tea** (eine Tasse Tee), nie *a bread*.
say.it: Ciò che non si conta, in generale, non ha articolo: **Honey is sweet.** (Il miele è dolce.) **I like tea.** (Mi piace il tè.) Anche **news** (notizie), **advice** (consiglio) e **money** (denaro) in inglese non si contano: **The news is good.** (Le notizie sono buone.) Per contarli: **a loaf of bread** (una pagnotta), **a piece of advice** (un consiglio), **a cup of tea** (una tazza di tè), mai *a bread*.
say.en: What you can't count takes no article when you mean it in general: **Honey is sweet.** **I like tea.** English can't count **news**, **advice** or **money** either: **The news is good.** To count them: **a loaf of bread** (never *a bread*), **a piece of advice**, **a cup of tea**.

exercises.text: Mrs Birkett is in the kitchen. There's ___ bread on the table, but there isn't ___ butter. — Have we got ___ eggs, Harry? — Yes, we've got ___ in the barn. — Good. Are there ___ walkers at the inn tonight? — Yes, two. — Then we haven't got ___ time! — Have ___ tea first, Mum!

translation.sl: Gospa Birkett je v kuhinji. Na mizi je nekaj kruha, masla pa ni. — Imamo kaj jajc, Harry? — Ja, nekaj jih imamo v skednju. — Dobro. So nocoj v gostilni kakšni pohodniki? — Ja, dva. — Potem nimamo nič časa! — Najprej popij malo čaja, mama!
translation.de: Frau Birkett ist in der Küche. Auf dem Tisch ist etwas Brot, aber keine Butter. — Haben wir Eier, Harry? — Ja, wir haben welche in der Scheune. — Gut. Sind heute Abend Wanderer im Gasthaus? — Ja, zwei. — Dann haben wir keine Zeit! — Trink zuerst etwas Tee, Mama!
translation.it: La signora Birkett è in cucina. Sul tavolo c'è del pane, ma non c'è burro. — Abbiamo delle uova, Harry? — Sì, ne abbiamo nel fienile. — Bene. Ci sono escursionisti alla locanda stasera? — Sì, due. — Allora non abbiamo tempo! — Prima prendi un po' di tè, mamma!
translation.en: Mrs Birkett is in the kitchen. There's some bread on the table, but there isn't any butter. — Have we got any eggs, Harry? — Yes, we've got some in the barn. — Good. Are there any walkers at the inn tonight? — Yes, two. — Then we haven't got any time! — Have some tea first, Mum!
